create_arize_phoenix_prompt_template: create an ArizePhoenixPromptTemplate instance with a template ID, messages, and metadata from Arize Phoenix
build_arize_phoenix_template_manager: build an ArizePhoenixTemplateManager to load, cache, and render prompt templates from Arize Phoenix using Jinja2
run_render_template: run render_template on ArizePhoenixTemplateManager with a template ID and variables to produce formatted chat messages
test_get_prompt_template: test the ArizePhoenixPromptManager.get_prompt_template method with a prompt ID and variables to get rendered messages and metadata
review_pre_call_hook: review the ArizePhoenixPromptManager.pre_call_hook method to merge prompt templates with existing messages and apply model parameters
